mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, reducing tranylcypromine levels, while the combination increases serotonin syndrome risk and carbamazepine may cause MAOI-induced hypertensive crisis due to sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid this combination; if necessary, use alternative anticonvulsant (e.g., valproic acid) or alternative antidepressant with careful monitoring for hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
